From b2ae75052a8c1611b2030fa49ba1c6b6439fa04f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: "lramos.prof@yahoo.com.br" <lramos.prof@yahoo.com.br>
Date: Tue, 11 Oct 2016 22:12:45 -0300
Subject: [PATCH] ide: Fix interface autodetection in legacy IDE driver (trial
 #2)

This humble patch was sent one or two months before, and had no actions,
except for a colleague reply which friendly pointed out some formatting
problems (which were solved in a second message).

It relates to an old code, the legacy IDE driver, but the bug it
addresses is real. The code, although rarely used, is
still there to be compiled if one chooses to do so (like me).

Also, the fix has a very low risk of present collateral effects IMHO.
It is already compiled and tested in some embedded machines.

So, again IMHO, it is worth be fixed.

This email is a second trial with it. I hope it can help the one or two
guys out there which are still running the legacy IDE driver and
haven't noticed the former email.

Fixes: 20df429dd667 ("ide-generic: handle probing of legacy io-ports v5")
Signed-off-by: Luiz Carlos Ramos <lramos.prof@yahoo.com.br>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/drivers/ide/ide-generic.c b/drivers/ide/ide-generic.c
index 54d7c4685d23..419818a39c27 100644
--- a/drivers/ide/ide-generic.c
+++ b/drivers/ide/ide-generic.c
@@ -96,10 +96,10 @@ static int __init ide_generic_init(void)
 		printk(KERN_INFO DRV_NAME ": please use \"probe_mask=0x3f\" "
 		     "module parameter for probing all legacy ISA IDE ports\n");
 
-		if (primary == 0)
+		if (primary)
 			probe_mask |= 0x1;
 
-		if (secondary == 0)
+		if (secondary)
 			probe_mask |= 0x2;
 	} else
 		printk(KERN_INFO DRV_NAME ": enforcing probing of I/O ports "
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/ide/ide-generic.c`**
- The conditional checks for `primary` and `secondary` variables have been modified:
  - The check `if (primary == 0)` has been changed to `if (primary)`, meaning it now checks if `primary` is non-zero (true) instead of checking if it is zero (false).
  - Similarly, the check `if (secondary == 0)` has been changed to `if (secondary)`, altering the logic to check if `secondary` is non-zero.

### Relationships Between Modifications
The modifications in `drivers/ide/ide-generic.c` are aimed at fixing the interface autodetection logic in the legacy IDE driver. By changing the conditions from checking for zero to checking for non-zero values, the patch ensures that the probing mask is set correctly when either `primary` or `secondary` is active. This change addresses a bug related to the detection of legacy IDE ports, improving the functionality of the driver for users who still rely on it. The patch is a follow-up to a previous attempt to fix the same issue, indicating ongoing efforts to enhance the legacy driver’s reliability.
